Class SpectrumIndex

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.SpectrumIndex
public class SpectrumIndex extends Object
Compressed-domain query index for spectra in an acquisition run.

Parallel arrays: offsets, lengths, retention times, MS levels, polarities, precursor m/z, precursor charges, base peak intensities. Kept entirely in memory; signal channels remain lazy on disk.

HDF5 layout: <run>/spectrum_index/ group with named datasets.

API status: Stable.

Cross-language equivalents: Objective-C TTIOSpectrumIndex, Python ttio.acquisition_run.SpectrumIndex.

    • SpectrumIndex

      public SpectrumIndex(int count, long[] offsets, int[] lengths, double[] retentionTimes, int[] msLevels, int[] polarities, double[] precursorMzs, int[] precursorCharges, double[] basePeakIntensities, int[] activationMethods, double[] isolationTargetMzs, double[] isolationLowerOffsets, double[] isolationUpperOffsets, int[] centroideds)
      Full constructor including the optional centroideds column.

      The four M74 activation / isolation arrays must be either all-null or all non-null with length equal to count. The centroideds array is independently optional: null for legacy files; otherwise length must equal count.

      public boolean centroidedAt(int i)

      Cross-language equivalents: Python SpectrumIndex.centroided_at(i), Objective-C -[TTIOSpectrumIndex centroidedAt:].

    • writeTo

      public void writeTo(StorageGroup runGroup)
      Write this index to a storage group (creates spectrum_index/ subgroup).

      parameter type relaxed to StorageGroup so the index can be written through any provider (HDF5, SQLite, Memory).

      The mathematically redundant offsets column is omitted; readers synthesize it from cumsum(lengths).
